evals.name: guide-sync
evals.prompt: Please translate docs/docs/guide/sync.md into Simplified Chinese for our zh-CN docs.
evals.expected_output: A zh-CN translation written to docs-i18n/zh-CN/guide/sync.md: complete, natural Chinese, glossary terms consistent, all Markdown/code/links/admonitions preserved.
assertions: Glossary terms applied (同步 / 端到端加密 / 密钥)

evals.name: reference-stats
evals.prompt: we need the atuin stats reference page in mandarin — it's under docs/docs/reference/stats.md
evals.expected_output: A zh-CN translation at docs-i18n/zh-CN/reference/stats.md that preserves the CLI example output / table verbatim and translates only the surrounding prose and code comments.

evals.name: faq
evals.expected_output: A zh-CN translation at docs-i18n/zh-CN/faq.md: prose reads idiomatically, questions/headings all translated, nothing dropped or invented.
assertions: Commands preserved (atuin account delete, atuin init zsh)
